note: No queryable zoning service found for Pemiscot County or its cities. County site and GIS aggregator pages link no GIS viewer or REST service. Caruthersville and Hayti zone by ordinance, but their district maps are on file at city offices (Hayti ecode 405.020(B)), not published online. Steele has no zoning map link. ArcGIS searches for Pemiscot zoning returned nothing. Regrid zoning is a paid add-on, not a public service.
